import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()
cur.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'\")
print('Tables:', cur.fetchall())
for row in cur.execute(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table'\").fetchall():
    tname = row[0]
    cur.execute(f'PRAGMA table_info({tname})')
    print(f'Schema for {tname}:', cur.fetchall())
    cur.execute(f'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM {tname}')
    print(f'Row count: {cur.fetchone()[0]}')
conn.close()
"

\"\"\")

conn.close()

conn = sqlite3.connect('/workspace/data.sqlite')
cur = conn.cursor()

# Verify all SQL queries return expected single-row, single-column results
queries = [
    ('eps_difference', \"SELECT (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-29' AND measure='Non-GAAP diluted net income per share' AND basis='non-GAAP' AND months=3) - (SELECT high FROM guidance WHERE period_end='2024-11-29' AND measure='Diluted EPS' AND basis='non-GAAP')\"),
    ('adjusted_operating_income', \"SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-11-29' AND measure='Non-GAAP operating income' AND basis='non-GAAP' AND months=3\"),
    ('adjusted_margin', \"SELECT (SELECT f.amount FROM financials f WHERE f.period_end='2024-11-29' AND f.measure='Non-GAAP operating income' AND f.basis='non-GAAP' AND f.months=3) / (SELECT f2.amount FROM financials f2 WHERE f2.period_end='2024-11-29' AND f2.measure='Total revenue' AND f2.basis='GAAP' AND f2.months=3) * 100\"),
    ('margin_bridge', \"SELECT ((SELECT f.amount FROM financials f WHERE f.period_end='2024-11-29' AND f.measure='Non-GAAP operating income' AND f.basis='non-GAAP' AND f.months=3) - (SELECT f.amount FROM financials f WHERE f.period_end='2024-11-29' AND f.measure='GAAP operating income' AND f.basis='GAAP' AND f.months=3)) / (SELECT f.amount FROM financials f WHERE f.period_end='2024-11-29' AND f.measure='Total revenue' AND f.basis='GAAP' AND f.months=3) * 10000\"),
]

for name, sql in queries:
    cur.execute(sql)
    row = cur.fetchone()
    print(f'{name}: value={row[0]}, matches_json={round(row[0], 6) if name != \"eps_difference\" else round(row[0],2)}')

conn.close()
"
